mail-config.email-desc: Set an email address you wish to send your internal transactional emails from (e.g. task notifications, team member mentions).

mail-config.temp-desc: Your email will be sent with erxes email template.
mail-config.default-email-service-desc: Choose your email service name. The default email service is SES.
mail-config.postal-address-desc: Your organization's physical address. Anti-spam law requires it in the footer of marketing email.
mail-config.postal-address-missing: Set a postal address — marketing email is required by law to carry one, and campaigns are sent without it until you do.
mail-config.sendgrid-api-key-desc: API key from your SendGrid account. Used to send mail and manage senders.
mail-config.sendgrid-subuser-desc: Optional. Scopes sender management to a SendGrid subuser.
mail-config.sendgrid-webhook-key-desc: Verification key from SendGrid's Signed Event Webhook. Delivery events are rejected until it is set, so bounces and spam reports stay unrecorded.
mail-config.verified-senders-desc: Addresses your provider allows mail to be sent from. A sender can only send after opening its confirmation link.

properties.remove-archived-in-use: Records still hold values or rules depend on it, so it stays in Archived.

properties.remove-has-dependents: Other rules depend on it, so it can only be archived.
